config.profiles: Agents that can be started from the **Agents** view, in addition to Claude Code (`claude`) and Codex (`codex`). A profile with the id `claude` or `codex` replaces the built-in one.
config.profiles.label: Name of the agent as the view shows it.
config.profiles.command: Command line that starts the agent. It runs in the shell of a new integrated terminal.
config.profiles.args: Arguments, each one quoted for the shell as needed.
config.profiles.cwd: Folder to start in. `${workspaceFolder}` is the workspace folder, which is also the default.
config.profiles.icon: Product icon of the terminal and the card, such as `sparkle`, `code`, `beaker`, `rocket`.
config.profiles.quietSeconds: An interactive agent that writes nothing for this many seconds is waiting for you. 0 never concludes that from silence.
config.profiles.matchCommand: Regular expression. A terminal in which a matching command line is started by hand becomes a session of this profile.
config.adoptCommands: Regular expression for command lines that make a terminal an agent session when no profile matches. It is tested against the command line without leading environment assignments and without the directory of the command. Empty adopts nothing.
config.notify: Controls the notification when an agent starts to wait for you, finishes or fails.
config.notify.attention: Notify unless the terminal of the agent is the active terminal of the focused window.
config.chatgptWeb.enabled: Offers **ChatGPT Web (via Codex)** in the **Agents** view of local windows: an agent that runs `codex -m chatgpt-web/<model>`, a row that tells whether the launcher of [codex-chatgpt-web](https://github.com/miuuyy/codex-chatgpt-web), Codex Web GPT, is ready, and the **ChatGPT Web** panel, which operates that launcher: its state, the bridge, the engine, the doctor. It is unofficial browser automation of your own ChatGPT account, not affiliated with OpenAI: the terms of OpenAI and the message allowance of ChatGPT apply. What needs the ChatGPT page (sign-in, smoke test, Install models) is done in the launcher, and its Install models routes **all** Codex traffic of this machine through the launcher.
config.chatgptWeb.codexConfigPath: The config file of Codex, of which only the top-level `openai_base_url` is read, to find the port of the launcher. The default follows the environment variable `CODEX_HOME`, as Codex does.
config.chatgptWeb.runtimePath: The command of the runtime of the Codex Web GPT launcher (`codex-chatgpt-web`). Empty: the newest one the launcher installed below `~/.codex-chatgpt-web/versions` (only the names of that directory are read), then `PATH`. When it is set, nothing else is looked for. It is a machine setting, and it is also the seam a test profile uses to name a stand-in, so that a window under test never reaches the real one.
config.chatgptWeb.launcherBundleId: The bundle id of the launcher app, which `open` and the quit event are addressed to. It is a machine setting, and it is also the seam a test profile uses to name a stand-in, so that a window under test never reaches the real one.
config.chatgptWeb.launcherAppPath: The app of the launcher. Empty: `/Applications/Codex Web GPT.app` or the same in `~/Applications`. Only whether it exists is asked. It is a machine setting, and it is also the seam a test profile uses to name a stand-in, so that a window under test never reaches the real one.
config.chatgptWeb.openCommand: The program that starts the launcher hidden and shows its window (macOS `open`). It is a machine setting, and it is also the seam a test profile uses to name a stand-in, so that a window under test never reaches the real one.
config.chatgptWeb.osascriptCommand: The program that sends the launcher the quit event (macOS `osascript`). The launcher is never killed. It is a machine setting, and it is also the seam a test profile uses to name a stand-in, so that a window under test never reaches the real one.
config.chatgptWeb.pgrepCommand: The program that tells whether the launcher runs (`pgrep`). It is a machine setting, and it is also the seam a test profile uses to name a stand-in, so that a window under test never reaches the real one.
config.chatgptWeb.codexCommand: The command of Codex, of which only `codex debug models` is ever run by the ChatGPT Web panel: no prompt is sent. It is a machine setting, and it is also the seam a test profile uses to name a stand-in, so that a window under test never reaches the real one.
